content.concept_description: The player attempts to sort matching colored jewels into respective chests under strings, but misplaces items and triggers a game over.
content.why_it_works: The tactile jewel sorting mechanism creates satisfying organization vibes, while deliberate player mistakes provoke viewer frustration and urge them to try it themselves.

visuals.primary_color: Yellow (#FFF9A6), Green (#8CD790), Ruby Red (#D11A38), Emerald Green (#179B58)
visuals.notable_objects: Jewel chests, stylized stylus pen, rubies, emeralds, diamonds

emotions.emotional_arc: Curious engagement with satisfying sorting shifts into tension and frustration upon repeated errors and failure.

end_card.cta_and_text: Amaze GO! (00:28), Google Play badge (00:28), App Store badge (00:28)

gameplay.core_gameplay_notes: A stylus pen selects and slides jewels along vertical strings to match the target color shown under treasure chests.

chapterization.chapter_description: Stylus sorts initial diamonds and rubies on strings.
Player completes the first sorting sequence.
Second level attempts jewel sorting with reversed chest colors.
Player misplaces jewels onto incorrect strings resulting in a big FAIL button.
End card displaying Amaze GO! app logo and store badges.
